verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's agentic workflows document auto-remediation scoped to level 1 alerts, with high-risk or complex cases automatically escalated for human expert review, so the core limit-and-escalate behaviour exists. However, the evidence never shows user-defined policies controlling what the agent may auto-remediate, and Starter Plan agent configurations explicitly cannot be customized. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable remediation policy controls, explicit handling of ambiguous findings, in-depth first-party docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human

citations.quote: high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
The agent configurations on the Starter Plan are standardized for all customers and cannot be customized.
